scope: Retrospective nominal USD school construction-contract cost from reported/as-built features; not tender-time or Saudi estimation
test_status: Previously exposed in v13. Diagnostic paired comparison only. No independent acceptance or 90-percent deployment claim may be made even if numerical gates pass.
target_policy: Keep every v13 row, partition, label and fixed-five identifier unchanged; no cost-based removals or target correction
data_repairs: Use explicit new-construction / TYPE OF ADDITION tables matched by nonmonetary fields only. Flag implausible class counts, preserve original numeric fields. Compare compact models excluding capacity/classroom inputs.
external_index: BLS PCU236222236222 via FRED, previous-calendar-year annual mean. Current revised vintage only, not historical point-in-time or Florida-specific index. Additions application unvalidated.
candidate_policy: Fixed 35 recipes: 3 unadjusted median baselines; full/compact features crossed with raw/PPI normalization and Ridge10/100, ExtraTrees leaf5/15, gradient boosting Huber/absolute depth2, neural32x2000/64x2000. No test-dependent ensembles or retuning.
selection: On pooled 2021/2022/2023 development folds, require MAPE and P95 no worse than global median baseline; among eligible candidates maximize within10, then minimize MAPE, then name. Median baseline is eligible fallback.
